title: Style and Grammar
slide_intent: Translate a conversational voice into repeatable editorial decisions so writing feels coherent across contributors.
strategic_value: Shared pronoun, casing and punctuation choices can make T-Mobile copy more consistent and inclusive.
demonstration: Two text columns separate style choices from grammar conventions with a vertical divider.
practical_value: Edit audience address and CTAs first, then check the specific capitalization and punctuation conventions.

content_islands.name: Page title
content_islands.spec: Place the title at left beneath the section label.

content_islands.name: Style rules
content_islands.spec: Set pronoun, abbreviation, CTA and fragment guidance in the middle column.

content_islands.name: Grammar rules
content_islands.spec: Separate capitalization, em-dash, ampersand and punctuation guidance in the right column.

ingredient.name: Conversational copy conventions
ingredient.role: Address the reader directly and reduce unnecessary language friction.
ingredient.application: Prefer first/second person, inclusive plural pronouns and sentence-case CTAs; use exclamation points sparingly and the guide’s specified casing for Unlimited and Un-carrier.
ingredient.scope: T-Mobile copy style; exceptions include space-limited abbreviations and occasional third person.
